video.title: AI欧腐《穿成Alpha的禁忌男伴侣/Transmigrated Into the Alpha's Forbidden Male Mate》
video.desc:
经典剧本 不过这建模我还挺喜欢
Saman falls, wakes up as the mate of Luke, a black wolf Alpha—and father to a cub named Keen. He remembers nothing. The pack hates him, the Alpha distrusts him, yet the cub calls him "Papa." Using modern knowledge, he heals the pack, fights enemies, and slowly wins them back. Then the truth breaks: he never transmigrated. He is the real Saman—the mate and father who simply lost his memory. Now he must reclaim the love and family that never stopped waiting. He forgot. They waited.
Saman意外坠落后醒来，发现自己竟成了黑狼 Alpha Luke 的伴侣，还多了一个名叫Keen的幼崽儿子。
他什么都不记得了。狼群厌恶他，Alpha 不信任他，可那个小幼崽却一声声叫他 “爸爸”。
凭借现代知识，Saman开始治愈狼群、对抗敌人，也一点点重新赢回众人的信任与爱。
直到真相揭开——他从未穿越。他就是原本的Saman，是Luke的伴侣，也是Keen的父亲，只是失去了记忆。
如今，他必须重新找回那份从未真正离开的爱与家人。
